This file is generated by neofetch_stats.py. Do not edit it by hand.
Each line below is one repository, in this format:
  <sha256 of owner/name> <total commits> <my commits> <additions> <deletions>
The repository name is hashed so private repository names stay private, and
lines are sorted by hash so the daily commit only shows what actually moved.
A repository is only re-scanned when its total commit count changes, which
keeps the daily GraphQL bill small. Delete this file to force a full rebuild.
